snippet.title: Holey
snippet.description:
Holey is a cooperative horror game where you and your crew are 
trapped in a collapsed tunnel. Scavenge resources across maps 
filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. 
Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the 
radio tower — if you survive.

🎮 Play the Demo on Steam (FREE):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4204020

Wishlist & follow for full release updates!
